Capabilities

Everything your operations team needs

From first whistle to final booking, Playdex provides every stakeholder with the tools to keep sports operations running at full capacity.

Event Management

Create, schedule, and manage sports events end-to-end. Track capacity, status, and participant flow in real time.

Venue Operations

Register sports facilities, track court capacity, and assign events to venues with conflict detection.

Booking Pipeline

Process participant registrations, manage seat allocation, and update booking statuses instantly.

Organisation Control

Manage multiple sports organisations and clubs with full CRUD access and event ownership.

Role-Based Access

Super admins create admins who manage operations. Fine-grained access control protects sensitive actions.

Live Dashboard

Real-time metrics on events, bookings, and venues. Always know the health of your sports network.

Multi-team participant management
Register individual athletes or full squads. Track registration status, allocate seats, and manage waitlists across every event type.
Flexible scheduling engine
Set start and end times for any discipline. Schedule round-robins, knockouts, or time-trial formats. Conflict detection prevents double-booking.
Venue-to-sport matching
Tag venues by sport type and capacity. Assign courts, pitches, pools, or tracks to events and always know what facility is available.
Process

Operational from day one

01

Super Admin activates the platform

The super admin signs in, creates admin accounts, and configures event types. Full platform control from a single privileged account.

02

Admins build the operations layer

Admins register organisations, add venues, schedule events, and manage the full operational catalogue.

03

Bookings flow and data is live

Participants book events in real time. Status updates propagate instantly across the dashboard for every team member.
